claims.question: q1
claims.claim: A knowledge graph can act as a semantic representation of an enterprise SQL database, queried via Text-to-SPARQL.
claims.quote: There is increasing evidence that question-answering (QA) systems with Large Language Models (LLMs), which employ a knowledge graph/semantic representation of an enterprise SQL database (i.e. Text-to-SPARQL), achieve higher accuracy compared to systems that answer questions directly on SQL databases (i.e. Text-to-SQL).
